<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="Codex线程模型" id="threads1"> <mxGraphModel dx="-594" dy="-177" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="660" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="parent" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="父 agent thread
（ThreadManager 管理的调度单元）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="280" x="80" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="limiter" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="AgentExecutionLimiter（execution.rs:14）
信号量式容量检查，Guard Drop 释放
上限 = max_concurrent_threads_per_session（可配置）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="280" x="80" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="spawn" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="spawn_agent（multi_agents_v2/spawn.rs）
fork_mode 可继承父完整历史
可覆盖 role / model / 推理参数" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="64" width="280" x="80" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="child1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="子 agent thread A
自己的 Session + run_turn" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="260" x="480" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="child2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="子 agent thread B
独立中断 / 独立恢复 / 独立模型" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="260" x="800" y="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="comm" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="通信：send_message / interrupt_agent / wait
agent_communication.rs + inter_agent_message.rs
子的输出作为 inter-agent message 进父的上下文" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="64" width="580" x="480" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="graph" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="AgentGraphStore：spawn 边持久化（谁派生了谁）
按 subtree 查询 thread id，重启恢复 agent 树" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="580" x="480" y="340" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reg" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="agent 注册表：core/src/agent/registry.rs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="580" x="480" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="parent" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" target="limiter" value="派发过 limiter"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="limiter" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="spawn"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="spawn" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontSize=11;fontColor=#2563eb;" target="child1" value="创建"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="spawn" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontSize=11;fontColor=#2563eb;" target="child2" value="创建"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="child1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;dashed=1;" target="comm" value="wait 收结果"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="child2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;dashed=1;" target="comm"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="child1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="graph"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
